blocks.URBAN00: Straight road running east-west (along x) through the middle, sidewalks along the north and south edges, two street lights and a drain. Completely open, no cover.
blocks.URBAN01: Straight road running north-south (along y), sidewalks along the west and east edges, two street lights. Completely open.
blocks.URBAN02: Crossroads: road in both directions with sidewalk corners in the four corners of the block, a fire hydrant and a litter bin. Open.
blocks.URBAN03: Open field of dirt with grass tufts and a couple of scorched patches. No cover.
blocks.URBAN05: 20x20 single tall warehouse (pink panel walls, blue metal roof with vents) filling the block inside a 1-tile pavement border; green roller doors in the south and east walls. Inside: rows of crate stacks and shelving, a small office with table in the north corner, a mezzanine floor along the north wall and in the north-east office reached by stairs.
blocks.URBAN06: 20x20 two-storey grey concrete shopping block with a pillared arcade along its south and east sides (phone booths, mailbox, bins). Ground floor: four shops (grocer, general store, butcher's, crate storeroom with roller door) with glass doors; stairs to an upper floor of flats with kitchens and dining tables; flat concrete roof.
blocks.URBAN07: 20x20 public park: iron railings around four lawn quarters, paved paths crossing the block with a central square flowerbed and tree; scattered apple trees, flowerbeds and bins. Gaps in the railings where the paths reach the block edges.
blocks.URBAN08: 20x20 three-storey blue-brick house (wooden floors; living room, kitchen, bedrooms, stairs) on a dirt yard enclosed by a tall wooden plank fence; a paved path from the south-east gap in the fence leads to the white front door on the east side; bins and planters by the walls.
blocks.URBAN09: 20x20 gas station: three pump islands under a concrete canopy on pillars in the south-west, a grey shop (counters, shelves) along the north, an open garage with tyres, drums and crates in the north-east and a small storeroom with a door in the south-east. Mostly open asphalt.
blocks.URBAN14: One-storey white clapboard cabin with a wooden floor filling most of the block (one room with kitchen corner, table and chairs, can pyramid), blue door on the north side; dirt-and-grass strip around it.
blocks.URBAN15: Two-storey blue-brick cottage (kitchen and table downstairs, stairs climbing west to a bedroom floor) in a garden of flowerbeds and apple trees inside a white picket fence; white front door on the south side with a paved path to a gate in the fence.
blocks.URBAN16: Walled garden: tall hedge around the border, grass inside with apple trees and flowerbeds giving scattered soft cover.
blocks.URBAN17: One-storey tall warehouse (panel walls, grey-tile flat roof) filling the block on a pavement border, crates stacked inside; glass shop door in the south wall, green roller door in the north wall.
blocks.URBAN18: Grey concrete corner shop: ground floor grocery (displays, counters, can pyramids) with a glass front door on the south side and stairs climbing north in the west corner to a partial upper storey over the back; the lower front annex has a flat roof.

notes: Slots in .MAP are floor, west, north, object. Doors: each closed door's alt is the other orientation (27<->28 etc.), so the pair given is both closed states. Hedge is the only pair where the W piece has the lower index (12W/13N). ROADS curb tiles are sidewalk-coloured with a curb on one side (named by where the road is), confirmed from URBAN00/01/02; ROADS 12 (another lane-marking variant) is unused in the blocks and left out. Street lights are a vertical stack (lamp-post on z0 and z1, street-lamp-top on z2) which the multi format can't express. Stairs: wood-stairs (21 low/22 high) and grey-stairs (48/49) climb north in URBAN08/06/18; grey-stairs-west (55 low/56 high) climb west in URBAN05/06/15. Shop counters: 84/85 are used in north-south runs (85 = till), 86 in an east-west run (URBAN06 y=0). Interior walls of brick houses use plaster or concrete wall pieces; outside faces use blue-brick. Grocery display names (produce-bin-*, drinks-display-*) are approximate guesses from small sprites. walk-cost 0 flowerbeds (URBITS 19/20) are passable. Chair facing inferred from placement next to tables in URBAN08.
